assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMembershipNumber

# of the registration date year. Runs after the customer code and registration date are
# set and before save, so the number is stored and returned with the owner.
assignMembershipNumber:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMembershipNumber
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# its normalized last name and postcode), so owners with the same last name and postcode
# share it automatically. Runs before save so the id is stored and returned with the owner.

# existing members of its household, storing the ceiling so the responder returns the
# capped level. Runs after the householdId is assigned and before save, so the new owner

  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMembershipLevelCap

  govern: [ transaction ]

# request before responding, so a later repeat of that key replays this owner.

  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The owner's honorific title. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Stored and returned, and used to compose the salutation.
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. May be supplied directly (flat form, kept for backward compatibility) or composed from the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields when those are present. Normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, street-type abbreviations expanded) and, in the structured form, returned as the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address. Optional; preferred over the flat 'address' when a non-blank value is present. Normalized like 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address. Normalized like 'address' and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's postcode. Optional; when present it must be exactly 4 digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and brackets on input; a leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise Australian country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a leading '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The owner's honorific title. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Stored and returned, and used to compose the salutation.
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. May be supplied directly (flat form, kept for backward compatibility) or composed from the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields when those are present. Normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, street-type abbreviations expanded) and, in the structured form, returned as the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address. Optional; preferred over the flat 'address' when a non-blank value is present. Normalized like 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address. Normalized like 'address' and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's postcode. Optional; when present it must be exactly 4 digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and brackets on input; a leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise Australian country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a leading '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present the owner's ageBand is derived from it. Accepted and returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner already occupies the same household (same last name and postcode) that would otherwise be rejected as a duplicate; the owner is created as a declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, derived on read - the title and last name separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the last name when no title is present.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's canonical region, the REGION segment of its customerCode. Derived from the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to the city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN'.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from its locality via the pinned region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Null when the locality has no entry.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' - the owner's region, the 2-digit fiscal year of the registration date, the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with lastName, and a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of <REGION><FY><HASH8>. A collision with an existing member id is de-duplicated by appending '-<n>'.
              type: string
              example: NSW261A2B3C4D5
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registration date, formatted 'FY<YY>', read back from the FY segment of its memberId. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named after the calendar year in which it begins (1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027 is FY26).
              type: string
              example: FY26
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic shared identifier for the owner's household, the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically; null for owners without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: 3f2504e04f89
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId contribute an empty segment when absent). Duplicate detection itself keys off the householdId (the household is rejected as a duplicate when already occupied, unless the create sets 'sharesHousehold').
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3f2504e04f89'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners who shared this owner's first and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3 once tenure reaches 1 elapsed fiscal year (fiscal year starts 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints - level 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' at membershipLevel 3 or above, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: STANDARD_METRO
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been registered for the current business day, flagging unusually high daily signup volume; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners, approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same lastName and postcode, different telephone); null when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read - 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans, derived on read - the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped left-to-right in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived on read from birthDate against registrationDate - 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Null when no birthDate is present.
              type: string
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical URI of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by its id.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; deleting an owner flags it true while retaining the record, so the owner is still returned by a GET.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'

The build is green. Here's what I did to unify the two identifiers into a single `memberId`.

## Summary

**New format** — `memberId` = `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`: region code, 2-digit fiscal year of the registration date, the 8 upper-hex SHA-256-over-(normalizedTelephone+lastName) HASH8 (the same one the old region-and-hash identity used), and a single Luhn check digit over the digits of `<REGION><FY><HASH8>`. The AUDIT line confirms it: `memberId=NSW2616E6609E3` (NSW · 26 · 16E6609E · 3).

**Where the logic lives**
- **`util/MemberId.java`** (new, replaces `CustomerCode`) — builds the id, de-duplicates collisions by appending `-<n>`, and reads the REGION and FY segments back out (fixed-width tail parsing, dedup-suffix aware). CHK reuses `util/Luhn`; HASH8 reuses `util/Sha256`.
- **`function/owner/AssignMemberId.java`** (new, replaces `AssignCustomerCode` + `AssignMembershipNumber`) — one step assigns the id, so collision handling now applies to `memberId`.
- **`util/FiscalYear`** — added a `label(String)` overload so the `FY` prefix convention isn't duplicated where the fiscal year is rebuilt from the id's segment.

**Threaded through everywhere the old fields flowed**
- `model/Owner` — `customer_code`/`membership_number` fields → single `member_id`; `getPrimaryIdentifier()` returns it.
- `mapper/OwnerMapper` — dropped the standalone `checkDigit` field; `locality` (→ owner segment) and `fiscalYear` now both read their segments back out of `memberId`, so it's the single source of both derivations.
- `AuditOwnerCreated` + `OwnerCreatedEvent` — audit line and structured event now carry `memberId`.
- `openapi.yml` (DTO codegen), the four dialect `schema.sql` files, and the `owners.POST.yml` wiring/comments — old fields removed, `memberId` added.

Doc references in `OwnerRegion`, `Sha256`, `FiscalYear`, and `ApplyRegistrationDate` were updated to point at the new identity. The one existing test plus the full suite pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`, 1 run / 0 failures).

One design decision worth flagging: the spec's phrase *"the fiscal-year value … must reference the memberId"* — I read the FY back out of `memberId` in the mapper (mirroring how `locality` reads REGION out of it), making the id the single source of truth. The alternative reading is to keep deriving `fiscalYear` from the registration date directly; both yield the same value, but I chose the former to satisfy the sentence literally and keep the design symmetric. Easy to switch if you intended the other.
